record.question: Answer any 4 (four) of the following: (a) What are the different kinds of traveling allowance that may be drawn in different circumstances by Govt. servants? Discuss briefly the Permanent Traveling Allowance. (b) What is meant by 'local journey'? How will you regulate traveling allowance of a local journey performed by a Govt. servant? (c) What do you mean by 'mileage allowance'? How will you regulate the road mileage of an officer who performs a journey between places connected by rail? (d) What do you mean by 'transfer'? What are the elements of traveling allowance on regular transfer? (e) What kinds of TA as on transfer are allowed to a retired employee if he settles down at the last station of duty itself but required to change of their residence? (f) If an Officer and his wife who is also a Government servant are both transferred at the same time from the same station to the same new station, how will their Transfer TA be regulated?
